semantic_changes: V7 is an authored semantic revision of router v6, not byte-equivalent to the original skill or a proven content-preserving compiler transformation.
Discovery frontmatter, shared rules and both example references remain byte-identical. Only the two example references retain complete verbatim-source mappings.
The extension existence/configuration check must complete in its own tool action before setup, without discovery or other project operations. Mixed output or failure cannot establish this checkpoint.

Broader discovery is optional, separate and scoped to known-existing roots. Absent optional integration directories are skipped; adapter discovery is unnecessary without config or supplied integration instructions. Stderr and exit status remain visible, and actual failures must be reported.
Required context reads may share a read-only action, but not an action containing setup, discovery, hooks or writes. Newlines and semicolons do not establish separate tool actions.

All v6 hook selection/rendering, authorization and condition handling, setup arguments, clarification and content guidance, append preservation, final readback and factual/Git narration rules remain unchanged.
